appDescription: Answers drivers with human-reviewed Korean traffic law information, including recent rule changes and rules that depend on the driving situation.

function.name: LIST_RULE_CHANGES
function.description: List reviewed traffic rule changes that took effect after the given month or that fall in the given period.

since.description: Year and month the driver last drove regularly, in YYYY-MM format.

period.description: Fixed time range of rule changes to list instead of a starting month.

function.name: ASK_RULE
function.description: Answer what the traffic law requires of a driver for a subject, narrowed by the situation the driver describes.

topic.description: Traffic rule subject the driver is asking about, or other when none of the listed subjects fits.

right_turn_traffic_light.description: Whether the intersection has a dedicated traffic light for right turns.

front_traffic_light.description: Color of the vehicle traffic light facing the driver before turning.

crosswalk_light.description: Color of the pedestrian light at the crosswalk the driver meets right after turning.

pedestrian_present.description: Whether someone is crossing or about to cross that crosswalk.

function.name: CONFIRM_RULE
function.description: Record that the driver understood the rule DRIVE RULE just read out, or read that rule out again.

action.description: Whether the driver confirmed the rule or asked to hear it again.
